svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #173 · Solar-system bodies: second pass, BRDFs, ephemeris geometry, textures, atmosphere
The renderer knew only point sources, so a resolved Earth, Moon or asteroid field could not be drawn;
now an optional second pass composites ephemeris-placed disks onto the star image before the noise draw.

g.text: Scene::from_catalog(focal_plane, stars, pointing, zodiacal)
StarInFrame -> PSF deposit -> star_image (mean electrons)
GalaxyInFrame via with_galaxies; both are surface-brightness splats
render_with_seed: zodiacal + dark + one Poisson draw
quantize_image clips at the full well
INVARIANTS section 1: a single Poisson stage over the combined mean

svg.text: no opaque, extended body anywhere in the chain

g.text: Earth-limb guiding from Mars could not be simulated
no ephemeris, no disk, no phase, no limb, no occultation of stars
Scene::with_second_pass(Arc<dyn SecondPass>, Epoch)
stars and galaxies unchanged; minor planets appended as StarData
feature = "solar-system"; None renders exactly as before
BodyPass::composite -> Composite { layers: BodyComposite }
SolarSystem::body_state: DE440s + satellite SPKs, light time, aberration
BodyStamp::build: Lambert / Hapke / textured tier x TSIS-1 solar rate
RayleighAtmosphere: single scattering, limb glow, two-way extinction
sky x (1 - coverage) + electrons, applied before dark and Poisson
tests: stamp total = electrons_per_sr x theta^2 x disk integral to 1e-3
planet_view: frames + FrameMetadata JSON + overlay SVG
HiRISE 2007 geometry, Horizons satellites and Ceres locked by tests
Earth, Moon, Mars, satellites and MPCORB asteroids render
textured Moon and Mars within 1-3 % of Mallama-Hilton V

svg.text: Not modelled: clouds, aerosols, multiple scattering, ocean glint, rings, satellite textures, self-luminous Sun; motion blur of bodies within an exposure.
